Schools are not mental health clinics. They are education centers.

"A lot of times we think about...merging the mental health system and the education system, because we think of it as breaking down silos.

But what we don't understand is that a lot of times the goals of those two systems are different."

@DrJenniferWeber & @CarolynGorman_ discuss the issues with school-based mental health, and why schools must focus on education:

This is an insane story. 

A 400 pound tiger lived in a New York City Housing Authority building for years, and *everyone in the building knew he was there*. For YEARS. 

NYCHA is supposed to inspect their buildings regularly.
posts.summary: NYCHA failed to inspect building despite years-long tiger presence
